_comments.azure_credentials: Azure authentication uses OIDC federated credentials (no client secrets). Required GitHub secrets: AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_ID_DEV_QA, AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_DEV_QA, AZURE_CLIENT_ID_STAGING_PROD, AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_STAGING_PROD. See config/subscriptions.json for the full mapping.
_comments.teams_webhook: Replace with your actual Teams channel webhook URL for notifications
_comments.backup_storage: Replace with your actual Azure storage account name for state backups
_comments.terraform_cache: Provider caching improves performance by avoiding repeated downloads
